subject: Acme Health SOC 2 / Compliance recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Health SOC 2 / Compliance recap & next steps

Hi Alex (and Priya in advance),

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points you shared:
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence for upcoming vendor review in Q4 (auditor deadline ~Oct 20).
- Audit log retention and access controls: sample retention policy requested for 7+ years, with exportable immutable logs.
- Data residency and DPA requirements for PHI-adjacent workloads.
- Pen test evidence and recent vulnerability remediation timelines; desire for a consolidated artifact package.

Goals and success criteria:
- Provide SOC 2 Type II report + control matrix that maps to Acme controls.
- Demonstrate audit log access and retention policy; provide sample logs (anonymized).
- Deliver a DPA draft with standard redlines addressed or identified.
- Provide pen test summary and remediation notes (last 12 months).

What Redwood will deliver (next actions):
1) Share SOC2 snapshot & control matrix (attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2027.pdf) by EOD tomorrow.
2) Share pen test summary and remediation timeline (attachment: pen-test-summary.zip) by Aug 17.
3) Send DPA-draft-v2.docx for your legal review; happy to take redlines.
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive with Rishi (runtime/infrastructure) and Neha (security/compliance) — propose Aug 19 or Aug 20.
5) Provide sample audit-log extracts (anonymized) and a short doc on retention policies and KMS integration details.

Open questions for Acme:
- Exact retention window your auditors expect (you mentioned 7 years — confirm).
- Any specific format or SIEM integration required for logs?
- Who should receive the DPA (legal contact) and the pen-test artifacts (security contact)?

Next steps / timeline:
- Alex/Priya confirm: retention window + contacts by EOD Aug 16.
- Redwood to deliver SOC2 snapshot + DPA draft by Aug 16 and pen test summary by Aug 17.
- Tech deep-dive (30-45m) week of Aug 19.

Thanks — we’ll aim to get the artifacts over and then use the deep-dive to answer any operational questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2027.pdf, DPA-draft-v2.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Health SOC 2 / Compliance recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — big help. Quick clarifications from our side:
- Retention: yes, auditors expect 7 years; for some financial-adjacent logs they may ask for 10, but 7 is baseline.
- SIEM: we use Splunk; if you can provide logs in JSON with timestamps and event IDs that will be easiest for us.
- Contacts: Priya (cc’d) will take the security artifacts (pen test, logs). Legal for the DPA is Mark Chen (mark.chen@acmehealth.com) — please route DPA to him.

We’re happy with the proposed timeline. Aug 19-20 deep-dive works for Priya and me; prefer morning PST.

Appreciate the quick turn.
—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of IT Security, Acme Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Acme Health SOC 2 / Compliance recap & next steps — internal/owners

Rishi / Neha — forwarding the final notes from the call with Acme. Summary of what we need from the infra/security side and owners below.

Ask list (owners):
- SOC 2 snapshot & control matrix (Rishi) — pull latest Type II report pdf and generate a simple control mapping doc to Acme’s controls. Target: EOD Aug 16.
- Pen test summary + remediation notes (Rishi) — include dates, CVE IDs, and current status. Target: Aug 17.
- Audit log samples + retention description (Neha) — provide anonymized JSON sample, explanation of retention policy (7 yrs), and SIEM export instructions for Splunk. Target: Aug 17.
- DPA prep (Neha + Legal) — attach current DPA draft (see DPA-draft-v2.docx) and mark sections likely to be redlined by Acme; coordinate with Mark Chen once they respond.

Scheduling: Alex/Priya prefer morning PST on Aug 19 or Aug 20 for a 30-45m technical deep-dive. Rishi — can you suggest two 30m slots on those dates?

Notes: we should anonymize any sample logs (no PII/PHI) and make sure artifacts have an index.md describing what’s included. I’ll upload the artifacts to the shared Drive folder and post the link here.

Thanks — let me know if anything is infeasible. I’ll track in HubSpot (ACME-2027) and send meeting invite once we lock a slot.
—Marissa
